sources.name: list
sources.cmd: D={{state}}/widgets/{{widget}}/data; mkdir -p "$D"; cd "$D" && printf '['; s=''; for f in $(ls 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[a-z0-9]+(\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+){4,5}\.t$' | head -60); do printf '%s"%s"' "$s" "$f"; s=,; done; printf ']'

sources.name: put
sources.cmd: D={{state}}/widgets/{{widget}}/data; mkdir -p "$D"; case "$HATCH_ARG" in *.t) ;; *) echo "not a timer file" >&2; exit 1;; esac; id="${HATCH_ARG%%.*}"; case "$id" in ""|*[!a-z0-9]*) echo "bad timer id" >&2; exit 1;; esac; rm -f "$D/$id".*.t; : > "$D/$HATCH_ARG"; printf '{}'

sources.name: del
sources.cmd: D={{state}}/widgets/{{widget}}/data; mkdir -p "$D"; case "$HATCH_ARG" in ""|*[!a-z0-9]*) echo "bad timer id" >&2; exit 1;; esac; rm -f "$D/$HATCH_ARG".*.t; printf '{}'

sources.name: notify
sources.cmd: command -v hatch >/dev/null || { echo "the hatch command is not on the server PATH" >&2; exit 1; }; hatch notify "$(printf '%s' "$HATCH_ARG" | tr _ ' ')" --level done --state {{state}} >/dev/null || exit 1; printf '{}'
